name: Women's Aid Organisation
summary: Gives free shelter, counselling and crisis support to women and children facing abuse, and campaigns for laws and attitudes that protect women's rights.
programmes: Emergency shelter for women and children
impact: 7,975 points of contact (hotline, WhatsApp, email, face-to-face) in 2025
87 women and children admitted to shelter in 2025
beneficiaries: Women and children experiencing domestic violence and other abuse

organisation.leadership: Lee Jia Ping (President); Nazreen Nizam (Executive Director) — per Annual Report 2025
organisation.accounts: Annual Report 2025 (lists a Financial Report 2025 appendix): https://wao.org.my/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/WAO-ANNUAL-REPORT-2025.pdf; reports back to 2000 at https://wao.org.my/annual-reports/
